title: I Asked the Lord That I Might Grow

candidates.title: I Asked the Lord That I Might Grow (Song)

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lines: I asked the Lord that I might grow
In faith, and love, and ev'ry grace
Might more of His salvation know
And seek more earnestly His face

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lines: 'Twas He who taught me thus to pray
And He, I trust, has answered prayer
But it has been in such a way
As almost drove me to despair

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lines: I hoped that in some favored hour
At once He'd answer my request
And by His love's constraining pow'r
Subdue my sins, and give me rest

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lines: Yea, more, with His own hand He seemed
Intent to aggravate my woe
Crossed all the fair designs I schemed
Blasted my gourds, and laid me low

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lines: "Lord, why is this?" I, trembling, cried
"Wilt thou pursue Thy worm to death?"
"'Tis in this way," the Lord replied
"I answer prayer for grace and faith"

lyrics.label: Verse 6
lines: These inward trials I employ
From self and pride to set you free
And break thy schemes of earthly joy
That thou may'st find your all in Me

candidates.notes: Used reference wording for all lines except Verse 4 line 4, where the transcript shows "Blasted my gourds, and laid me low" differing from the reference; included that line as heard. All other lines follow the reference lyrics.

candidates.title: I Asked the Lord that I Might Grow • T4G Live II [Official Lyric Video]

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lines: I asked the Lord that I might grow
In faith, and love, and ev'ry grace
Might more of His salvation know
And seek more earnestly His face

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lines: 'Twas He who taught me thus to pray
And He, I trust, has answered prayer
But it has been in such a way
As almost drove me to despair

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lines: I hoped that in some favored hour
At once He'd answer my request
And, by His love's constraining pow'r
Subdue my sins, and give me rest

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lines: Instead of this, He made me feel
The hidden evils of my heart
And let the angry pow'rs of hell
Assault my soul in ev'ry part
Yea, more, with His own hand He seemed
Intent to aggravate my woe
Crossed all the fair designs I schemed
Humbled my heart, and laid me low

lyrics.label: Bridge
lines: Lord, why is this? I, trembling, cried
Wilt thou pursue Thy worm to death?
'Tis in this way, the Lord replied,
I answer prayer for grace and faith

lyrics.label: Outro
lines: These inward trials I employ
From self and pride to set you free
And break thy schemes of earthly joy
That thou may'st find your all in Me

candidates.notes: Human‑written captions contain numerous mis‑hearings (e.g., “I ask” vs “I asked”, “heal” vs “feel”, truncated phrases, and garbled wording). The transcript clearly shows the first three verses and parts of Verse 4, the bridge and the outro, but many lines are missing or corrupted. Structure was therefore taken from the reference lyrics; no section repeats were detected in the transcript. Discrepancies were corrected to match the reference wording.
